description.en: A pixel-brutalist dashboard kit with monochrome geometry and stacked charts.
description.zh: 像素与粗野主义风格的仪表盘模板，使用单色几何元素和堆叠图表。

source.description: Pixel-brutalist dashboard template with monochrome geometry and stacked charts

subject.zh: 悬浮的黑白棋盘陶瓷方砖

description.en: A complete rounded square brick seen from an elevated three-quarter view, uniformly inset from every corner. The independent projected shadow makes its weight and hover gap legible.
description.zh: 完整的圆角厚方砖从斜上方呈现，整体统一缩放，为四角保留安全距离。独立投影表现重量与悬浮间隙。

description.en: Pure black and white inlays carry the identity. Physical ceramic shading, controlled reflections and soft bevels provide detail without a pixel-art treatment; white cells remain solid after extraction.
description.zh: 黑白镶嵌构成标识。陶瓷明暗、克制反光与柔和倒角提供精致细节，不使用像素画处理；白色格块在抠图后依然保持不透明。

description.en: Cool pale drafting paper uses fine Cartesian cells, larger construction divisions, registration crosses and a short ruler. Its separate soft floor shadow never enters transparent UI marks.
description.zh: 浅冷色制图纸配细笛卡尔网格、较大的工程分区、定位十字与短标尺。背景和柔和地面投影独立保存，小型透明标记不带底纹或阴影。

palette.source: Selected Dotty presentation, 2026-09-07-01/01; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: At 128/64 px the checker rhythm, rounded thickness and hover shadow remain clear. At 32/24/16 px the transparent mark retains the alternating block silhouette; fine bevel reflections and drafting lines are deliberately left to the large presentation.
sizeNote.zh: 128/64 px 保留棋盘节奏、圆润厚度与悬浮阴影；32/24/16 px 透明图标以黑白交错轮廓为主，精细倒角反光与工程格线留给大尺寸展示。

goal.en: Reuse dashboard layouts, controls, and charts to build data interfaces with a cool monochrome visual style.
goal.zh: 复用看板布局、控件和图表，搭建采用冷色灰阶风格的数据界面。

description.en: Fine Cartesian subdivisions, stronger construction lines and registration crosses give the checker block a drafting ground.
description.zh: 细密坐标线、较强的基准线与定位十字，为黑白陶瓷方砖铺开一张绘图纸。

alt.en: Floating black-and-white checker ceramic block on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 悬浮的黑白棋盘陶瓷方砖，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.zh: 用清晰的黑白，呈现信息。

description.zh: 悬浮的黑白棋盘陶瓷方砖。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥59px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 59px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
